type: Experimental deterministic heuristic; not a clinically trained or validated model
processing: On-device only. Energy envelope retained in RAM for 30 seconds, then discarded. Only compact numeric features are persisted. No network service.

inference.deepHypothesis: 600 s of regular usable envelope after initial sleep context; correlation >=0.65, interval CV <=0.15, acoustic activity <0.05
inference.remHypothesis: 90 s of variable usable envelope after initial sleep context; correlation >=0.25, interval CV >=0.22, acoustic activity <0.1
inference.unknown: Capture gap, no usable envelope, legacy epoch without features, speech contamination, partial epoch, or insufficient sustained context
inference.cycles: No clock-driven 90-minute cycles or target phase proportions

limits: Pattern similarity is not physiological measurement
Awake breathing and other people/noise may be misclassified
Unknown spans excluded, never interpolated as sleep
Time asleep is detected estimated time, not extrapolated through missing intervals
Synthetic tests check code behavior only; physical overnight comparison pending
